identity.title: Identity Verification
identity.content1: KYC (Know Your Customer) is an identity verification and investigation process designed to verify customer identity information and background, ensuring financial institutions or service providers comply with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT) regulations. It helps ensure account security and reduces the risk of fraud and illegal activities.
identity.title2: Why do I need KYC verification?
identity.content2: KYC is implemented to protect your account security and rights. It safeguards your identity information and background, preventing others from impersonating you for fraudulent or illegal activities.
identity.title3: Having issues with identity verification? Need help?
identity.content3: If you encounter any problems during the KYC process, please contact our customer service for assistance. Our support team is ready to provide you with the necessary help and answers. Please provide specific questions and relevant information to help us assist you more efficiently.
